read.text: My name is Anna. I am a student. I live near the school with my family.
Today is Monday. The weather is sunny and warm. I will walk to school with my brother.
I have a small dog. Its name is Lucky. Every morning, I take Lucky for a walk in the park.
My favorite food is noodles. I like to eat noodles with my friends after school. They are cheap and delicious.
Last weekend, I went to the museum with my family. We saw many old paintings. It was a fun day.
I usually get up at seven o'clock. I eat breakfast, brush my teeth, and then go to school by bus.
My sister likes to read books. She reads every night before she goes to bed. She wants to be a writer.
This weekend, I want to visit my grandmother. She lives in the countryside. I will bring her some fruit.

Jenny and I had been best friends for many years. We talked about everything and did lots of things together. But something has changed since last Friday. She won't speak to me or answer my calls. She doesn't even want to see me. I really don't know what's wrong between us.

Mary and Kate were two lazy sisters. They never helped their mom clean the house or wash the dishes. They said they were too busy with their homework, but the truth was that they always had time for watching TV and playing computer games. Their mother was so angry that she decided to leave the family for a few days.

It was a beautiful night! There was a full moon in the sky. The stars shone brightly. Ken and Barbie were taking a walk in the park. Suddenly, Ken took Barbie's hand and said, "Will you marry me, my dear?" Hearing this, Barbie just couldn't wait to say "yes" and cried tears of happiness.

Sandy is a member of the Lin family. She is six years old and comes from England. Now she is a student at DC school, where she is learning how to behave herself. The Lins miss Sandy very much so they visit her every weekend. Every time when Sandy sees them, she always barks happily.

Mrs. Simpson collects things. She likes coins and stamps the most. Sometimes she spends thousands of dollars buying an old stamp. Mr. Simpson thinks this is really crazy and stupid. He just doesn't understand why a tiny piece of paper can cost so much! But he still respects his wife's hobby.

During the spring break, Tom and Jack went to the beach. When they got there, the beach was already full of people. Tom took off his T-shirt and jumped into the water. Jack just sat on his easy chair and watched lots of beautiful girls passing by. Both of them had so much fun on the beach.

Rosa's Café is a very popular place to eat. People love to go there because the food is delicious, and the service is excellent. By the way, Rosa is the name of the owner's daughter. She is young, pretty, and always has a smile for every customer. That's also why Rosa's Café is so crowded all the time!

Today is December 22nd. Everyone in my family is busy decorating our house for Christmas. My parents have already put a lot of presents under the Christmas tree in the living room. Christmas is a big day. Christmas Eve is important too. People usually have a big dinner that day. This year we're going to have a delicious dinner at a restaurant. My mother is happy about this because she doesn't need to cook.

Once upon a time, there was a giant who had a beautiful garden. Many children liked to play in his garden but he wasn't happy with it. He made them leave and built up high walls to keep them away. The Spring felt sorry for the children so she never visited the garden again. Only the Winter stayed with the lonely selfish giant.

Computers have changed our lives in both a good way and a bad way. Speaking of the benefits of computers, we can get information very easily and quickly through the Internet. On the other hand, not all the information we find on the Net is true. That's why we have to double check over and over again before we can believe what we read on our computers.

My sister and I rode our bicycles to the garden, where we found a football hidden behind the bushes. We met a local student who had just opened a jar of pickles. He gave us the pickles, and we gave him the football. It was a good deal, and we all had fun together.

The big guy from school worked all day to clean the mountain trail. He found an empty bottle next to a rugby ball and a cotton cap. Later, he played with a black cat near the space exhibit and added new signs for visitors.
In 2023, Jim Rowan introduced a new SUV model that combined smart technology, electric power, and a cool design. It quickly gained attention in the auto industry.
Alan Wang, who lives in New Taipei City, loves DIY. He spends his weekends making shelves, fixing stuff, and posting fun how-to videos online to inspire others to try it themselves.

This summer, I got a part-time job at a small café not far from my home. I worked five days a week, taking orders, making drinks, cleaning tables, and talking to customers. I felt tired sometimes, but I enjoyed the work and learned something new every single day.

I have a cute dog named Lucky. He is small and has brown and white fur. Every day, I take him for a walk in the park near my house. He likes to run, bark, and play with other dogs. At home, he sleeps on my bed. I love him so much.

On weekends, I enjoy relaxing and spending time with my family and friends. I usually stay home, watch movies, listen to music, or read a good book. Sometimes I invite my friends to ride bikes together or go to the park in the neighborhood to play basketball. These simple things make me feel happy, calm, and ready for a new week.

Susan went to the computer store to buy a new laptop. There was a big sale on that day and she was pleased that she could save money. When she got to the store, she saw hundreds of people lined up to go inside. Susan thought it was more important to save time than money. So she went home!

Last week was such a bad week. On Monday I missed the bus and was late for school. On Wednesday I lost my wallet. Then on Friday I forgot to bring my homework and my teacher scolded me. I hope this week is a little bit better.

In some American schools, dogs are helping students to read. Every week, teachers bring dogs into the library for students to read to. Students don't feel any pressure when they read to dogs, so they are more confident. Teachers say the dogs have helped the students improve their reading skills.

I have lots of things to do this weekend. On Saturday, I have to clean the house. Then on Sunday I need to cook and prepare for my friends to come over. It's my best friend's birthday so I want it to be special.

Tim likes to buy new clothes every month. I think it's a very bad habit. Last month, he came over to show me his new leather jacket. He was very happy because he bought it on sale. But then when he left he asked me to lend him money for this month's rent.

The Olympics is a very large sporting event held every four years. The summer games include running, gymnastics, and swimming. The winter games include hockey, skiing, and skating. For some athletes, being in the Olympics is a dream come true.

Matt was a waiter in an expensive restaurant. One day he was serving very important customers. While delivering their drinks, he accidentally spilled red wine on a woman's blouse. Now he washes dishes in the kitchen.

There's a very famous book called "The Little Prince." It was written by a French author, but it has been translated into many different languages. This book is popular with both children and adults, and was voted the best book of last century. Have you read it? If not, you should!

Mr. and Mrs. Johnson have been married for thirty years. They have four children and thirteen grandchildren. For their thirtieth anniversary, their children and grandchildren gave them a wonderful gift. It was two around-the-world plane tickets. Now Mr. and Mrs. Johnson can spend the next year traveling wherever they want.

Janet put an ad in the newspaper for a new roommate. She asked for a roommate that was quiet, tidy, cheerful, and a non-smoker. Over the week she met many applicants, but she still wasn't happy with any of them. Then one applicant said to her, "Janet, you're not looking for a roommate. You're looking for a houseplant."

Christmas is my favorite holiday. Besides receiving presents, I enjoy decorating the Christmas tree. I usually make a string of popcorn and wrap it around the tree. Then I place gifts under the tree and a star on top. It always makes my living room so warm and cheerful.

Steve wants to be a professional basketball player. Not only does he play on a team, but he practices by himself every day. He runs five kilometers every morning and shoots baskets after school. Before going to bed, he reads basketball magazines. You could say basketball is his life.

Sally's favorite clothes are a pair of blue jeans and a striped blouse. She wears this to school every day. Then her dad gave her some money and told her to buy some new clothes. The next day Sally wore her new outfit: new blue jeans and a new striped blouse.

Emily loves eating Italian food. She goes to her favorite Italian restaurant at least once a week. And when she got tired of the restaurant's food, she decided to take a trip to Italy. That's a long ways to go just to eat!

The students wanted to do something to help the environment so they began a recycling program. Everyone was asked to recycle glass bottles and paper. The program helped reduce the school's garbage by 50%.

I thought there was something wrong with my computer. Every time I turned it on, it made a funny sound. But then I hit it really hard with my hand and the noise stopped. I wonder if I really fixed it.

There are many bears living in the forests of western Canada. They are generally not dangerous because they are afraid of humans. But if you walk up to a mother bear and her cubs, be careful! She will be scared and will try to protect her babies. Then you are in trouble!

Luke bought a beautiful new bike. To go with the bike, he bought a new helmet, sunglasses, and some fancy cycling clothes. He looked very good with his new things. Unfortunately he wasn't able to use any of his new things for very long. His bike got stolen because he forgot to buy a lock.

Kim doesn't trust banks so she keeps all of her money at home. Some of the money is under her bed, some in her closet, and some is even in the fridge. She hides her money so well that she can never find it when she wants it.

Mr. Jones was in a hurry to get to the airport. He packed his suitcase quickly and flagged down a cab. When he got to the airport he discovered that he had forgotten his passport. He had left it on the kitchen table.

Paul went to the doctor because he felt pain all over his body. "Watch," he said, "wherever I touch, it hurts." He touched his ear, his neck, his knee, and each time he cried: "Ouch!" The doctor nodded and said, "I know what's wrong with you. Your finger is broken!"

India is a beautiful country to visit. In the north there are the Himalaya Mountains, and in the south there are beautiful beaches. Every year hundreds of thousands of tourists go there to enjoy the natural scenery and the ancient ruins. Is India a place you'd want to visit?

One day, Jimmy's roommate asked him to look after the cat for the weekend. All he had to do was feed it. When Jimmy's roommate came back, he saw his cat in the bathtub. The poor animal was trying to drink water out of the faucet. Jimmy gave the cat food but had forgotten to give it water!

Ted didn't have enough time to study for his test, so he decided to cheat. He wrote all the important parts of his textbook on little pieces of paper. When he actually wrote the test, however, he didn't have to look at his cheat notes. While trying to cheat, he was also studying!

In the Chinese culture, the number four is considered unlucky. In the west, however, thirteen is considered unlucky. Some older buildings don't have a thirteenth floor. Also, some people think bad things might happen to them on Friday the 13th. Do you believe this is true?
